layers.name: Cap limit (25 to 38 ft past the pit rim, with the ramp)

props.name: Cap limit
props.note: Smooth alignment, 25 to 38 ft past the pit rim. At the southwest corner it comes in to the crest of the ground. It keeps off the haul road. Tightest curve 34 ft radius. The tongue on the southeast is the ramp down the old haul road cut.

layers.name: Pit rim (top of the pit walls)

props.name: Pit rim
props.note: Top of the pit walls, from the lidar slopes and the fill contact. The cap limit is measured from this line, with side notches closed over.

props.name: Drainage divide
props.note: Ground inside this line drains to the pit today. 0.13 ac of it lies outside the cap limit and goes to the perimeter ditch.

layers.name: Top of 3H:1V slope (start of 6 percent deck)

props.name: Top of perimeter slope
props.note: Outside this line the cap falls to the limit at 3H:1V. Inside it the deck rises at 6 percent to the crown.

layers.name: Let-down ramp in the old haul road cut

props.name: Let-down ramp
props.note: Cap runs down the old cut at 3H:1V for 83 ft, from 1,415 ft at the top to 1,389 ft at the saddle. Runoff leaves over the saddle to the Herman Impoundment. No closure berm. The cut walls stand above the ramp, up to 23 ft at the saddle; the liner turns up against them.

props.name: r4 cap limit
props.note: Revision 4: crossed the north notch 25 to 34 ft past the crest.

layers.name: Rim low points, crown and surveyed pit bottom

props.name: North notch
props.note: Lowest point of the rim today. Under the cap, with a closure berm 25 ft past it.

props.name: Northeast saddle
props.note: Low point of the rim. Under the cap.

props.name: Southeast saddle
props.note: Crest of the old haul road cut floor. The ramp ends here. Runoff carries on south down the cut, across the haul road, to the Herman Impoundment.

props.name: Cap crown
props.note: Highest point of the cap. Tree tops around the pit are at 1,415 to 1,446 ft.

props.name: Surveyed pit low point
props.note: Field survey, August 17, 2026. NAVD88.

props.name: North notch
props.note: Cap ends 10 ft past the crest of the notch (was 25 to 34 ft). The notch is 12 ft deep between its shoulders, so it is still plugged with a closure berm up to 10 ft. The old road from BIA 120 is kept up to the berm toe. Ditch outlet N: down the old road to the existing culvert under BIA 120 and the North Wetland. Cap limit is clear of the NWWRP outline. Past the rim: 11 to 33 ft. Top of slope: 1,405 to 1,409 ft.

props.name: Northeast
props.note: Cap passes over the 1,391 ft saddle on a low berm, up to 9 ft. Ditch outlet NE. Past the rim: 27 to 38 ft. Top of slope: 1,409 to 1,413 ft.

props.name: East bench
props.note: The bench above still drains this way (about 0.1 ac in all). The perimeter ditch takes it. Past the rim: 31 to 38 ft. Top of slope: 1,414 to 1,419 ft.

props.name: Southeast, old haul road cut
props.note: The cap slopes down the old haul road cut as a ramp to the saddle. No plug berm. Runoff from this corner goes down the ramp and on to the Herman Impoundment. The cut walls stand above the ramp and need a liner termination. Deep waste beyond (MW-53, 42 ft) is outside this cap. Past the rim: 31 to 43 ft. Top of slope: 1,419 to 1,422 ft.

props.name: South rim
props.note: Limit sits on the slope above the haul road. The road is untouched. Past the rim: 22 to 38 ft. Top of slope: 1,415 to 1,421 ft.

props.name: Southwest
props.note: Corner pulled back to the crest of the ground so the edge needs little fill (berm up to 6 ft, was 11 ft). The cap ends at the crest here instead of 25 ft past it; the ground falls away steeply to the haul road. Ditch outlets W and SW cross under the road to the Herman Impoundment. Past the rim: 0 to 23 ft. Top of slope: 1,411 to 1,415 ft.

props.name: West bench
props.note: Level bench. The ditch carries this side south to outlet W and the Herman Impoundment, so nothing heads toward the Elem Colony. Largest share of cap runoff (2.6 ac). Native rock at the rim (SB-33). Past the rim: 24 to 38 ft. Top of slope: 1,401 to 1,410 ft.

props.name: Northwest corner
props.note: Low rim. The knob at 1,400 to 1,403 ft is under 5 ft or more of cap. Past the rim: 27 to 38 ft. Top of slope: 1,401 to 1,405 ft.
